final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS value FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_modelconf FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_modelconf > b.value), reference AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS value FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - b.value AS above_baseline, q.avg_modelconf / r.value AS relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN baseline AS b CROSS JOIN reference AS r WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL AND r.value IS NOT NULL
